remarks: Charming and updated, this downtown Greenwich home offers a bright, open layout with an inviting kitchen featuring Carrera marble counters, breakfast island, and top-tier appliances. The living and dining areas flow seamlessly for easy everyday living. Upstairs are two spacious bedrooms and a beautifully finished bathroom. The lower level includes a flexible family room, exercise space, and laundry area. Radiant floor heating on the first and lower levels and ultra-efficient mechanicals help keep utility costs low. Private driveway with space for three cars. Ideally located just moments from the shops, restaurants, and entertainment of Greenwich Avenue, as well as the train station-this home is a dream for NYC commuters and anyone seeking luxurious in-town living.
